description: FEES student self-service surface: the (app)/fees/me screen gated on fees.view_own — outstanding total, charges ledger with per-row payable checkboxes, receipts list, and a PAY flow that creates a Razorpay order (POST /me/payments), opens Razorpay Checkout, optimistically verifies (POST /payments/verify), and refetches /me/charges + /me/receipts + /me/outstanding. Money stays a paise STRING end to end; the single allowed Number() is the annotated Razorpay SDK boundary. Depends on FEAT-003 (money helper, fees hooks, keys, status badge).
steps: Extend apps/web/src/features/fees/hooks.ts (or add to it) with the student hooks: useMeOutstanding (api.get('/api/fees/me/outstanding'), enabled can('fees.view_own')), useMeCharges (GET /api/fees/me/charges), useMeReceipts (GET /api/fees/me/receipts), useCreatePayment mutation (POST /api/fees/me/payments { chargeIds }), useVerifyPayment mutation (POST /api/fees/payments/verify { razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature }). createPayment uses zodResolver-free direct body (createPaymentSchema is safe but validated server-side); verify body matches verifyPaymentSchema. On verify success invalidate feesKeys.meCharges/meReceipts/meOutstanding.

Create apps/web/src/features/fees/useRazorpay.ts: a hook that injects <script src='https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js'> once (idempotent — return early if window.Razorpay already defined), tracks { ready, error } state, resolves ready when the script loads and error when it fails. Add a minimal Razorpay window type (declare global) so strict tsc compiles.

Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/me/page.tsx gated on fees.view_own (RouteGuard requirePermission='fees.view_own' and/or <Can>): a summary card showing formatPaise(outstanding.outstandingPaise); a charges table (useMeCharges) rendering each LedgerCharge (category, description, dueDate, outstandingPaise via formatPaise, status via FeeStatusBadge) with a per-row checkbox enabled only for not-PAID charges; a receipts table (useMeReceipts). Accumulate the selected charges' outstandingPaise with BigInt for a 'selected total' display (formatPaise).

Wire the PAY flow (design §6.4) into the student screen. Step 1 (script): disable the Pay button unless useRazorpay().ready; if error show inline 'Payment is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.'. Step 2 (create order): on 'Pay selected', useCreatePayment.mutate({ chargeIds: selectedIds }) -> { razorpayOrderId, amountPaise (STRING), currency:'INR', keyId, paymentTransactionId }; handle 409 'one or more charges are not payable' (toast + refetch meCharges), 409 'payable amount out of range' (toast 'This amount can\'t be processed. Contact the fees office.'), 502 'payment gateway unavailable' (toast), 404 no profile (inline 'No student profile found.'). Button disabled while the create mutation is pending (double-click guard).

Step 3 (open Checkout): new window.Razorpay({ key: res.keyId, order_id: res.razorpayOrderId, amount: res.amountPaise, currency: 'INR', name: 'Institution', handler, modal: { ondismiss: () => { toast('Payment cancelled.'); refetch meCharges } } }).open(). Pass res.amountPaise (the paise STRING) VERBATIM. ONLY if the installed SDK rejects the string form, the single permitted exception is Number(res.amountPaise) at THIS .open() call, annotated exactly `// SDK-boundary: safe Number() — amount bounded by PaiseAmount`. No other Number()/parseFloat/float*100 on money anywhere.

Step 4 (verify, optimistic): in handler(resp), useVerifyPayment.mutate({ razorpay_order_id: resp.razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id: resp.razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature: resp.razorpay_signature }); on 200 { ok:true, pending:true } show a 'Payment received — processing' state (NOT 'paid') and invalidate meCharges/meReceipts/meOutstanding; on 400 'invalid payment signature' toast 'We couldn\'t confirm that payment; it will be reconciled automatically.' (do NOT mark failed — the webhook is authoritative).

Step 5 (settlement): after verify, refetch the ledger/receipts; clear the 'processing' banner once meCharges shows the charge PAID or a new receipt appears. Optionally add a bounded refetchInterval on meOutstanding while a payment is 'processing' (~5s up to ~60s, then stop).
acceptance_criteria: app/(app)/fees/me/page.tsx exists, gated on fees.view_own, showing outstanding (formatPaise), a charges table with per-row payable checkboxes (not-PAID only), a receipts table, and a Pay-selected button.
The Razorpay flow drives create -> open -> verify -> refetch per design §6.4; verify result is shown as 'processing' (never 'paid'); the webhook stays authoritative.
No client amount is sent on order-create (only chargeIds); res.amountPaise is passed to Checkout as a STRING; the only Number() on money is the single annotated SDK-boundary line, if used at all.
features/fees/useRazorpay.ts injects the SDK idempotently and exposes { ready, error }; a Razorpay window type is declared so strict tsc compiles.
npm run lint -w @campusgate/web passes and npm run build -w @campusgate/web succeeds.
grep of apps/web/src/features/fees/** finds no disallowed money float ops except the one annotated SDK-boundary line.
verification: Grep apps/web/src/features/fees for Number(|parseFloat(|* 100 and confirm the only money match is the annotated // SDK-boundary line.
findings:
Implemented the student self-service fees surface.

Files changed:
- apps/web/src/features/fees/hooks.ts: added student hooks useMeOutstanding(refetchMs: number|false — bounded settlement poll, default false), useMeCharges, useMeReceipts, useCreatePayment (POST /api/fees/me/payments, errors surfaced to caller — NOT auto-toasted, because the PAY flow has per-status handling), useVerifyPayment (POST /api/fees/payments/verify, onSuccess invalidates feesKeys.meCharges/meReceipts/meOutstanding). Added response types Outstanding, CreatePaymentResult, VerifyPaymentResult, VerifyPaymentBody.
- apps/web/src/features/fees/useRazorpay.ts: NEW. Idempotent checkout.js injector (early-return if window.Razorpay already defined; reuses an existing <script> tag if present), returns { ready, error }. Declares minimal global Window.Razorpay types (RazorpayConstructor/Options/Instance/HandlerResponse) so strict tsc compiles. amount typed string|number at the type boundary.
- apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/me/page.tsx: NEW. Gated by <RouteGuard requirePermission="fees.view_own">. Outstanding summary card (formatPaise), charges table with per-row native checkboxes (disabled for PAID), selected-total via BigInt sumPaise, receipts table. PAY flow per design §6.4: create -> open Razorpay Checkout -> optimistic verify -> invalidate/refetch. Verify success shows a 'Payment received — processing' banner (never 'paid'); 400 invalid-signature toasts the reconcile message without marking failed. 409 not-payable (toast + refetch), 409 out-of-range, 502 gateway, 404 no-profile (inline) all handled. Pay button disabled unless script ready AND selection non-empty AND no create/verify pending (double-click guard). Bounded settlement poll on meOutstanding (5s, up to 60s) while processing; banner clears when all charges PAID or a receipt appears.

Money rule: the ONLY Number() on money anywhere is the single annotated line `// SDK-boundary: safe Number() — amount bounded by PaiseAmount` at the Razorpay .open() call in page.tsx. grep of apps/web/src/features/fees/** has zero float-money ops.

Checkbox: no shadcn checkbox primitive exists and @radix-ui/react-checkbox is not installed; used a native styled <input type=checkbox> (design §3.8 primitives list does not include checkbox, and scope forbids adding deps). Accessible via aria-label.

NOTE for later steps (NOT fixed here — out of FEAT-004 scope): the (app) route group is NOT a URL segment, so the route is served at /fees/me, but apps/web/src/components/shell/AppShell.tsx NAV and apps/web/src/lib/landing.ts point at /app/fees and /app/fees/me. Existing staff pages already link to /fees/... (no /app prefix). The /app-prefixed nav/landing hrefs appear to be a pre-existing mismatch from an earlier FEAT and would make the nav link / student landing 404; confirm and reconcile href base (likely drop the /app prefix) in a follow-up.

Verification (both pass, this commit): `npm run lint -w @campusgate/web` exit 0; `npm run build -w @campusgate/web` exit 0 with /fees/me emitted (5.26 kB). packages/shared/dist/index.js confirmed present before build.
